name: Kare no Ai wa Kanojo o Kowasu
source:
Hatori Mio has lost both her parents and step-parents.
Hatori Takara, her elder step-brother, showers her with love to the point of abnormality.

December 23rd. With Christmas drawing near, Hatori Mio was eating lunch with her friend at university, as usual.
Her friend, Mayu, invites her to a year-end party...
This is a story that happens from that one scene.

[Translated from the [url=http://ryuankamei.tuzikaze.com/pro/kareai/kareai.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
羽鸟澪先后失去了亲生父母与养父母。
她的义兄羽鸟高良对她宠爱有加，甚至到了在外人看来有些异样的地步。

12月23日。圣诞节近在眼前，羽鸟澪像往常一样在大学里和朋友一起吃午饭。
席间，朋友真由邀请她参加忘年会……
故事便从这一幕正式拉开序幕。

[译自[url=http://ryuankamei.tuzikaze.com/pro/kareai/kareai.html]官方网站[/url]]
